tools.name: trigger_list_runs
tools.description: List task runs, filtered by status, task, tag, queue, schedule or a time window. This is the main read for 'what ran, and what failed?'. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs.

tools.name: trigger_get_run
tools.description: Fetch a single run's outcome — its status, output, error and attempts. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/result.

tools.name: trigger_get_run_trace
tools.description: Fetch the full execution trace of a run — every span, with timings and nesting. The tool for 'where did this run spend its time, and where did it break?'. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/trace.

tools.name: trigger_get_run_span
tools.description: Fetch a single span from a run's trace, with its own logs and attributes. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/spans/{spanId}.

tools.name: trigger_list_run_events
tools.description: List the lifecycle events of one run — queued, dequeued, started, retried, completed. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/events.

tools.name: trigger_get_run_metadata
tools.description: Fetch the mutable metadata a run has written about itself — progress, checkpoints and custom state. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/metadata.

tools.name: trigger_get_batch_results
tools.description: Fetch the outcome of every run in a batch. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/batches/{batchId}/results.

tools.name: trigger_list_schedules
tools.description: List the cron schedules configured for tasks, with their next run times. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/schedules.

tools.name: trigger_get_schedule
tools.description: Fetch a single schedule with its cron expression, timezone and active state. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/schedules/{scheduleId}.

tools.name: trigger_list_queues
tools.description: List task queues with their concurrency limits and current depth — where you look when work is backing up. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/queues.

tools.name: trigger_get_queue
tools.description: Fetch a single queue's concurrency limit, running count and queued count. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/queues/{queue}.

tools.name: trigger_get_current_deployment
tools.description: Fetch the deployment currently serving the key's environment — its version, git ref and status. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/deployments/current.

tools.name: trigger_list_env_vars
tools.description: List the environment variables configured for a project environment. Values may be redacted depending on the key's permissions. READ ONLY — this server exposes no env-var writes. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectRef}/envvars/{env}.

tools.name: trigger_list_waitpoint_tokens
tools.description: List outstanding waitpoint tokens — runs paused waiting for an external signal. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/waitpoints/tokens.

tools.name: trigger_list_bulk_actions
tools.description: List bulk replay and cancel operations and their progress. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/bulk-actions.

tools.name: trigger_cancel_run
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight run. Note this is the one endpoint on API v2, not v1. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v2/runs/{runId}/cancel.

tools.name: trigger_replay_run
tools.description: Re-run one specific past run with the same payload. This EXECUTES your production task again — the same side effects it had the first time. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v1/runs/{runId}/replay.

tools.name: trigger_reschedule_run
tools.description: Change when a delayed run will execute. Only applies to runs that have not started. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v1/runs/{runId}/reschedule.

tools.name: trigger_add_run_tags
tools.description: Attach tags to a run so you can filter for it later. Additive and safe. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v1/runs/{runId}/tags.

tools.name: trigger_activate_schedule
tools.description: Resume a paused schedule so it fires again. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v1/schedules/{scheduleId}/activate.

tools.name: trigger_deactivate_schedule
tools.description: Pause a schedule so it stops firing. The usual first move when a scheduled task is misbehaving. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v1/schedules/{scheduleId}/deactivate.

tools.name: trigger_pause_queue
tools.description: Pause a queue so its runs stop being dequeued, or resume it. The containment move when a task is failing in a loop. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v1/queues/{queue}/pause.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "trigger_list_env_vars" references sensitive artifacts (environment variable). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the environment variables configured for a project environment. Values may be redacted depending on the key's permissions. READ ONLY — this server exposes …

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "trigger_list_env_vars" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.
